senses.definition: A region of the stratosphere, between 15 and 30 kilometres in altitude, containing a relatively high concentration of ozone, which absorbs most solar ultraviolet radiation.

The ability of a material to resist the deteriorating effects of ozone exposure.

A disorder caused by the inhalation of ozone at high altitudes (e.g. in passenger aircraft), marked by fatigue and breathing difficulties.
A treatment that purports to increase the amount of oxygen to the body through the introduction of ozone by various means.
